task: author a skill package on disk
definition: Write SKILL.md with its frontmatter and body and add the resources and scripts the skill needs, as a directory on disk.
outcome: a skill directory exists on disk with a valid SKILL.md and the resources or scripts it references; it has not been packaged, uploaded, or enabled anywhere

records.outcome: a skill folder with a valid SKILL.md exists on disk, textual only, ready to be wrapped in a plugin
steps: Create a folder named after the skill
Add a SKILL.md file starting with YAML frontmatter carrying name and description
Write the instructions as markdown after the frontmatter
Make the folder name match the name in the frontmatter
Keep contents to text files only: .md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml, .csv
If Claude hands back a .skill file, keep the folder it came from instead

evidence.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills
evidence.quote: A skill is a folder named after the skill, holding a `SKILL.md` file. The file starts with YAML frontmatter carrying `name` and `description`

records.notes: The text-only rule applies to skills delivered through the admin portal; a plugin upload containing scripts or binary assets is rejected.

records.outcome: a skill directory exists on disk with a SKILL.md carrying valid name and description frontmatter, markdown instructions, and the reference, asset, or script files it needs
steps: Create a directory named exactly as the skill's name field
Start SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, max 64 characters) and description (max 1,024 characters)
Write the markdown body with step-by-step procedures, examples, templates, and edge cases, keeping it under 500 lines
Add detailed documentation to references/, templates and data to assets/, and executable code to scripts/
Reference those files from SKILL.md so Claude knows when to load them
Declare Python or npm dependencies in the frontmatter dependencies field

evidence.quote: The `SKILL.md` file must start with YAML frontmatter containing required metadata, followed by markdown instructions.

records.notes: Sections Directory structure, Creating a SKILL.md file, Adding resources, and Adding scripts form one authoring sequence.
